protocol: Naval training chamber. Average initial oxygen duration 5 min with measured dwell varying. Mask-off hypoxia exposure at 25,000 ft up to 5 min, followed by up to 5 min at peak with pressure breathing.
outcome_window: Participants were asked after descent about symptoms during the flight. Delayed follow-up unavailable.
note: The overall published bends rate is less than 0.5%, with no exact all-grade count. Table I gives 700 aviators, 2,405 advanced students and 1,295 passengers. The severity grading is the source's historical Adler scale.
